[LSER.13.5.1] **The `gap-policy` phrase** declares how a *time-integrating*
aggregation advances across intervals where no new sample is asserted:
`gap hold` (carry the last value — the default when the phrase is omitted),
`gap zero` (absence = zero, for rate sensors), or `gap skip` (exclude
dead-sensor intervals; requires a bounded `scope ttl`/`scope explicit`
schema). `gap`, `hold`, `zero`, and `skip` are reserved ([LLEX.9.5]).
The phrase is **optional and applies only to time-integrating aggregations**
(`integral`); on any other aggregation it is a compile error — applicability
is a compile-time contract check on the same axis as [LSER.16–17], not a
grammar constraint.
